import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { activateBackendCaveFormation } from '@src/api/bot/cave-formation-actions';
import { BackendAPIError } from '@src/api/bot/client';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

function activationMessage(error: unknown, keyword: string): string {
  if (error instanceof BackendAPIError) {
    if (error.code === 'NOT_FOUND' || error.code === 'CAVE_FORMATION_INVALID_KEYWORD') {
      return '未找到可激活的阵盘，请输入阵盘名称，例如：/激活阵盘 隐息阵盘';
    }
    if (error.code === 'CAVE_FORMATION_INVALID_TEMPLATE') {
      return `【${keyword}】不是可激活的阵盘。`;
    }
  }

  return error instanceof Error && error.message ? error.message : '激活阵盘失败，请稍后重试';
}

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const keyword = (e.MessageText || '').replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?激活阵盘\s*/, '').trim();

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (!keyword) {
    md.addText('用法：/激活阵盘 阵盘名称');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('示例：/激活阵盘 隐息阵盘');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '激活阵盘', content: md, footer: [{ label: '洞府阵法', command: '/洞府阵法' }] }));

    return;
  }

  const footer = [
    { label: '洞府阵法', command: '/洞府阵法' },
    { label: '万宝楼', command: '/商店 万宝楼' }
  ];

  try {
    const result = await activateBackendCaveFormation(bid, e.uid as number, keyword, createBackendRequestContext(e));
    const messageText =
      result.outcome === 'refreshed'
        ? `你重新布下【${result.formation.formationName}】，持续时间已刷新为 ${result.durationHours} 小时。`
        : result.outcome === 'replaced'
          ? `你以【${result.formation.formationName}】替换了同类阵法【${result.replacedFormationName}】，新阵持续 ${result.durationHours} 小时。`
          : `你成功布下【${result.formation.formationName}】，持续 ${result.durationHours} 小时。`;

    md.addText(messageText);
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '激活成功', content: md, footer }));
  } catch (error) {
    md.addText(activationMessage(error, keyword));
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '激活失败', content: md, footer }));
  }
});
